services.title: Residential Construction
services.summary: Custom independent houses, villas, duplex homes, and residential apartment buildings constructed with transparent pricing, branded materials, and structural warranty.
deliverables: Architectural floor planning & 3D elevations
Soil investigation & reinforced foundation engineering
Framed RCC structure with Fe-550 TMT rebars & Grade 53 cement
Complete brickwork, plastering, premium electrical & plumbing MEP
Vitrified tile flooring, teakwood main doors & CP fittings
CMDA / DTCP plan approvals & local body building sanctions

services.title: Joint Venture Development
services.summary: Equitable and transparent joint venture partnerships for plot owners looking to maximize property value with clear legal agreements and timely delivery.
deliverables: Optimal land valuation & legal title scrutiny
Fair profit / built-up area sharing ratios
100% funding and construction management by GS Sowmiya Builders
Statutory approvals, RERA compliance & marketing support
Active joint ventures in Vengaivasal and Vignarajapuram

services.title: Turnkey Construction Contracts
services.summary: Single-window turnkey execution from raw land to key handover, eliminating subcontractor hassles and budget escalations.
deliverables: Fixed-budget construction packages (Standard, Premium, Luxury)
Itemized Bill of Quantities (BOQ) with zero hidden clauses
Stage-wise milestone payments aligned with physical progress
Daily/weekly digital site photo updates for homeowners
Proven execution in Manivakkam, Vengaivasal, Punchery & Kamarajapuram

services.title: Renovation & Remodeling

deliverables: Structural assessment before alteration
Vertical expansion & additional floor construction
Complete bathroom and kitchen modernizations
Terrace heat-reflective tile and waterproofing solutions
Electrical rewiring and plumbing overhaul

services.title: Interior Design & Decoration
